verdict.rationale: Obsidian's evidence shows a plugin API, URI triggers, and a headless Sync client aimed at CI/agent use, but nothing documents an actual automation/scheduling system that runs tasks autonomously in the background inside Obsidian itself — headless Sync only concerns syncing vault data, not executing logic. Missing for 10: a documented automation/workflow engine, scheduled or event-triggered background tasks, and any hands-on confirmation that such automations run unattended.
